(6)
It shall be lawful for the Spiritual Head to appoint a
Board of Trustees to the Corporation and a Board of Trustees
to each institution set in the First Schedule to this Act and
such  persons  shall  hold  office  during  the  pleasure  of  the
Spiritual Head:
Provided,  however,  the  first  Board  of  Trustees  of  the
Corporation and the first Board of Trustees to each institution
set out in the First Schedule to this Act shall be appointed
by  the  Spiritual  Head  and  such  persons  shall  hold  office
during the pleasure of the Spiritual Head.
(7) The Board of Trustees or the managing body, as the
case may be, of any Mosque, Thakkiya, Madrasa, Charitable
Trust, Place of Religious Resort or any other institution may
apply to the Corporation to be affiliated. The Spiritual Head
of  the  Corporation  may  in  his  absolute  discretion  allows
such application. The provisions of this Act shall apply to
such Mosque, Thakkiya, Madrasa, Charitable Trust, Place
of Religious Resort or any other institution, as the case may
be, in the event of such application is allowed.

6.

make rules to give effect to the principles and provisions of
this Act, it shall be lawful for the Spiritual Head to make
rules to—

(a)
determine eligibility for membership, mode of

admission,  withdrawal, 
expulsion 
and
resignation and fees payable of members;
